recommendedAction.proposedMeaning: If the recipient cannot continue, identify whether a web preview, App Clip or full app opened. For someone who only needs details, send date, time zone, venue and a direct way to reply. For a normal meeting invitation, use the organizer’s approved provider workflow; do not treat an app preview as a provider RSVP or a subscription URL.
recommendedAction.whyBounded: Adds a next action at the point of recipient friction; all deeper permission, update and export instructions already exist in the locale.
recommendedAction.sourceBoundary: Google Spanish body supports a provider invitation alternative, not a universal no-account Cloud flow.
